ProfileGravatar.DefaultImageDescription: Image displayed by Gravatar when no profile picture is associated with the hash.
ProfileGravatar.GravatarHashSegmentHelp: SHA256 (or MD5) hash of the visitor email address
ProfileGravatar.RatingDescription: Gravatar users self-rate their pictures. Pictures rated above this level are replaced by the default image. G is suitable for all audiences.
ProfileGravatar.ShowInVisitsLog: Show the Gravatar picture in the visits log
ProfileGravatar.ShowInVisitsLogDescription: Displays a small profile picture next to the visitor details for visits with a known Gravatar hash.
ProfileGravatar.TagManagerGravatarHashDescription: SHA256 hash of the visitor email address, provided by your website (for example a Data-Layer variable such as {{sha256_email_address}}). Never use the email address itself. Displays the Gravatar picture of the visitor in Matomo (ProfileGravatar plugin).
